data.name: Tyrell
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘tyrrel’, meaning ‘tireless’ or ‘strong hill’. Used in Middle English as a surname, and later adopted as a given name in the English-speaking world. In Christian tradition, Tyrell is a name for those who embody strength and perseverance.
